Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১) Computer software includes which of the following?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Software is a set of programs, which is designed to perform a well-defined function.
A program is a sequence of instructions written to solve a particular problem.
There are two types of software
1.System Software
2.Application Software.
Application Program, OS, Packaged Program all are included in Computer Software.
Source: তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি (একাদশ - দ্বাদশ শ্রেণী) প্রকৌশলী মজিবুর রহমান।

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২) Specialized program that allows user to utilize in specific application is classified as -
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Application programs are specialized that allows users to utilize specific applications.
These programs perform a particular function directly for the users.
Some of the common application programs include Email, web browsers, gaming software, word processors, graphics software, media player, etc.
All of these programs provide an application to the end-users, so they are known as application programs.
For example - a web browser is used to find information while gaming software is used to play games.
The requests for service and application communication systems used in an application by a programmer is known as an application program interface (API).
Source: Techcopaedia website

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৩) Translator for low level programming language were termed a -
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
A program written in a low-level language can be converted to machine level language by using assembler.
Source: Techcopaedia website.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৪) Program which is used to control system performance is classified as
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
System software controls a computer’s internal functioning, chiefly through an operating system, and also controls such peripherals as monitors, printers, and storage devices.
Source: Britannica.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৫) The software used to drive microprocessor-based systems is called:
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
The Software used to drive microprocessor-based systems is called an Assembly language program.
An Assembly language is a low-level programming language for microprocessors and other programmable devices.
It is not just a single language, but rather a group of languages.
Source: Techcopaedia website.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৬) The items that you can physically touch in a computer system are called:
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Computer hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices.
Internal hardware devices include the motherboard, hard drives, and RAM.
External hardware devices include monitors, keyboards, mice, printers, and scanners.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৭) Which of the following errors occurs when software tries to access protected memory?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
A Segmentation fault occurs when the software tries to access the protected memory.
A Segmentation fault is a common condition causing the programs to crash. it is generally associated with a core file and is triggered by a machine trying to read or write an unauthorized position of the memory. In other words, it is a memory access violation error. A Segmentation fault is always an error in the run time.
Source: Techcopaedia website.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৮) _____ is the process of finding errors in software code?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Debugging is a methodical process of finding and reducing the number of bugs, or defects, in a computer program or software code. Whereas, Testing is the process of finding bugs in already developed software not in software code.
Source: Google Book

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৯) Software, such as viruses, worms, and trojan horses, that has a malicious intent is known as ____.
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
The term malware refers to software that damages devices steals data, and causes chaos.
There are many types of malware — viruses, Trojans, spyware, ransomware, and more.
Source: AVG Technologies

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১০) Which program is run by BIOS to check hardware components are working properly while the computer is turned ON?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Full form of POST - Power On Self Test.
When power is turned on, POST (Power-On Self-Test) is the diagnostic testing sequence that a computer's basic input/output system(or ''starting program'') runs to determine if the computer keyboard, random access memory, disk drives, and other hardware are working correctly.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১১) An error in software or hardware is called a bug. What is the alternative computer jargon for it?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp: In several usages in information technology, a glitch (pronounced GLIHTCH) is a sudden break in function or continuity.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১২) Set of programs which consist of full set of documentation is termed as -
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Software packages describe a set of software that fulfills a particular function.
Example: installation on the desktop.
Source: Technopedia.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১৩) All of the following are examples of storage devices except
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Printer is an output device.
An output device is any hardware device used to send data from a computer to another device or user.
A storage device is any type of computing hardware that is used for storing, porting or extracting data files and objects.
Example: hard disc drives, floppy disc drives, cd drives
Source: Technopedia.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১৪) Regarding a VDU, which statement is more correct?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option1: ক) It is a system device
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option2: খ) It is an input device
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option3: গ) It is a peripheral device
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option4: ঘ) It is a hardware item
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Visual display unit (VDU) or video display terminal (VDT): any device used with computers to display images.
It typically consists of a computer monitor or similar display device and a keyboard, and could also include a mouse.
For example, a flat panel display and a projector are both examples of VDUs.
So, it is a peripheral device.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১৫) What is the full form of OSI -
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
OSI:
The Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) Model is a conceptual and logical layout that defines network communication used by systems open to interconnection and communication with other systems.
Source: Technopedia.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১৬) The personnel who deal with the computer & its management put together are called?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Humanware is defined in IT as hardware or software that is built around user capabilities and user needs. This often involves creating a particular visual or physical interface for a given set of users. The design and engineering of humanware starts with the user's interests and needs first, and designs the infrastructure accordingly.
Source: Technopedia.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১৭) Process is -
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option1: ক) program in High-level language kept on disk
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option4: ঘ) a job in secondary memory
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp: A process is an active entity, which exucutes a program.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১৮) A combination of hardware and software that facilitates the sharing of information between computing devices is known as-
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Network/Computer network,
Two or more computers that are connected with one another for the purpose of communicating data electronically.
Besides physically connecting computer and communication devices,
a network system serves the important function of establishing a cohesive architecture
that allows a variety of equipment types to transfer information in a near-seamless fashion.
Source: Britannica.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ১৯) What is the difference between mnemonic codes and machine codes?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option2: খ) Machine codes are in binary, mnemonic codes are in shorthand English.
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option3: গ) Machine codes are in shorthand English, mnemonic codes are in binary.
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.option4: ঘ) Machine codes are in shorthand English, mnemonic codes are a high-level language.
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Machine code/language: the numeric codes for the operations that a particular computer can execute directly.
The codes are strings of 0s and 1s, or binary digits, which are frequently converted both from and to hexadecimal (base 16) for human viewing and modification.
Example: 10011
A programming code that is easy to remember because the codes resemble the original words,
such as MPY for multiply and ACC for accumulator
Source: Britannica.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২০) Which is not application software?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Windows NT একটি Operation System তথা System Software.
Windows XP is an Operating system too. But, there is no system software named WinWord XP. WinWord is the executable filename of MS Word. So, the best option is Windows NT.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২১) What type of software program filters incoming network traffic?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
A firewall is a system designed to prevent unauthorized access to or from a private network.
A firewall also logs information about network traffic, which can help an administrator understand and prevent attacks.
Source: Britannica.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২২) Trackball is a -
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Trackball is an input device.
Trackballs and mechanical mice operate alike, using a rubber or rubber-coated ball that turns two shafts connected to a pair of encoders that measure the horizontal and vertical components of a user’s movement, which are then translated into cursor movement on a computer monitor.
Source: Britannica.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২৩) Which disc is used to ‘cold boot’ a Computer?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Cold boot is the process of starting a computer from shutdown or a powerless state and setting it to normal working condition.
It is the system disk because the other disks may boot a PC,
but they also perform added functions beyond booting the PC.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২৪) Which of the following types of virtualization is also characteristic of cloud computing?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Virtualization can be applied broadly to just about everything that you could imagine.
Memory
Networks
Storage
Hardware
Operating systems

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২৫) What is the full form of DNS?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
DNS stands for Domain Name System.
A DNS is an internet service that translates a domain name into a corresponding IP address. Domain name used here is alphabetic and can be easily remembered.
For example,www.example.com is a domain name of a site.
Source: Britannica.com

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২৬) According to NIST(National Institute Of Standard and Testing) which is not the characteristics of cloud computing?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
According to NIST(National Institute Of Standard and Testing) stability is not the characteristics of cloud computing.
Resource scalability, On demand and pay as you go are the three characteristics of cloud computing.
Source: তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি(একাদশ - দ্বাদশ শ্রেণী), প্রকৌশলী মজিবুর রহমান।

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২৭) Cloud computing is primarily __ types.
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
According to the location or deployment cloud computing are primarily 3 types
public cloud
private cloud
hybrid cloud
Source: তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি(একাদশ - দ্বাদশ শ্রেণী) প্রকৌশলী মজিবুর রহমান।

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২৮) The Elastic Computing Cloud (EC2) of Amazon is based on
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
Iaas (infrastructure as a service):
ক্লাউড সেবাদানকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান তাদের নেটওয়ার্ক, সিপিইউ, স্টোরেজ, ও অন্যান্য মৌলিক কম্পিউটিং রিসোর্স ভাড়া দেয়,যেখানে ব্যবহারকারীরা তাদের প্রয়োজনীয় অপারেটিং সিস্টেম ও সফটওয়্যার চালাতে পারেন।
অ্যামাজন এর ইলাস্টিক কম্পিউটিং ক্লাউড (EC2) এরকম একটি মডেল।
Source: তথ্য ও যোগাযোগ প্রযুক্তি(একাদশ - দ্বাদশ শ্রেণী) প্রকৌশলী মজিবুর রহমান।

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ২৯) What is the meaning of VPS
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
A virtual private server (VPS) is a virtual machine sold as a service by an Internet hosting service.
The virtual dedicated server (VDS) also has a similar meaning.

Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.question: ৩০) Which protocol is used in communication between Web Clients and Server?
Computer Fundamentals (Hardware & Softwa.exp:
HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol) standard application-level protocol used for exchanging files on the World Wide Web.
HTTP runs on top of the TCP/IP protocol.
Web browsers are HTTP clients that send file requests to Web servers which in turn handle the requests via an HTTP service.
Source: Britannica.com
